rationale.brand_personality: Cambium is a patient operator with an editorial mind and an instrument-maker's precision.
rationale.type_direction: Use a humane, high-contrast serif for the cause and the long horizon; use a rigorous humanist sans for state, decisions, evidence, and controls.
rationale.pairing_logic: Newsreader makes the brand feel lived-in, reflective, and distinct from the geometric sans language of AI tooling. IBM Plex Sans keeps operational surfaces highly legible and introduces technical credibility without turning the product cold.

primary.name: Newsreader
primary.use_for: wordmark exploration, display headlines, doctrine quotations, long-horizon statements, and editorial reports
primary.source: Google Fonts / SIL Open Font License
primary.fallback_stack: Newsreader, Iowan Old Style, Baskerville, Georgia, serif

secondary.name: IBM Plex Sans
secondary.use_for: body text, navigation, labels, evidence, controls, dashboards, and all small operational copy
secondary.source: Google Fonts / SIL Open Font License
secondary.fallback_stack: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

optional_monospace.name: IBM Plex Mono
optional_monospace.use_for: receipts, event IDs, timestamps, hashes, and replay snippets only
optional_monospace.fallback_stack: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

implementation.css_variables: :root { --font-display: 'Newsreader', 'Iowan Old Style', Baskerville, Georgia, serif; --font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; --font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; --type-ratio: 1.25; }
implementation.loading_strategy: Self-host WOFF2 subsets for latin; preload only Newsreader 500 and IBM Plex Sans 400 used above the fold; load remaining weights asynchronously. Preserve system fallbacks without layout collapse.

usage_rules: Never set operational status, buttons, or dense data in Newsreader.
Never use IBM Plex Mono as a cyberpunk decorative texture.
Use sentence case for headings; reserve uppercase for short evidence labels.
Keep body measure between 55 and 72 characters on reading surfaces.
Do not set the wordmark from a generated raster; typeset and refine it separately.
